Theorem
[Constant-Rank Level Set Theorem] 1. chA:A.24Suppose $\bar{M}$ and $N$ are smooth manifolds, and $\Phi : \bar{M} \to N$ is a smooth map with constant rank $r$. Every level set of $\Phi $ is a properly embedded submanifold of codimension $r$ in $M$.
